children: Shell's results are strong across the board but $8.5 billion in operating cash flow from its downstream unit is a highlight, Jefferies analyst Mark Wilson writes. The call with management later today will likely focus on new projects like Bay du Nord offshore Canada, its upcoming capital markets day and the broader outlook, he says. Shares rise 3.3% to 4,089 pence. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
